messages:
priya-cs: Kickoff for Mosaic cohort — 10 seats go live Mon 2026-04-06. Need final enroll list, an enablement workshop, and a lightweight feedback loop. Flags: Finix flagged as a potential renewal pressure, Acero has a legal/data residency hold.

devon-ps: I can own the tech enablement. 45m + Q&A works. Proposed Wed 2026-04-01 10:00 PT. I'll also drop a 3-question baseline pulse.

aj-sales: I'll confirm seat approvals. Finix is likely in but asking for ROI metrics. Acero requires a legal contact — I have their lawyer on copy.

maria-cs: Can we add simple health signals to the tracker: "first-48h tokens/user" and "first-success-path completed"? Makes it easy to spot struggling accounts.

priya-cs: Yes — add to the onboarding doc (see the tracker). Also we should tag renewal risk in gainsight. @maria-cs can you add the risk tag + short note about Acero's legal hold?

maria-cs: Done. Created tag `pgm_mosaic_renewal_risk` and added per-account notes; Acero note references legal hold ticket #4021.

onboarding-bot: Reminder scheduled: enrollment emails will go out 2026-04-03 09:00 UTC to 10 participants.

devon-ps: Feedback loop plan: pulse at 24h, 7d, 28d. Questions: (1) Was setup straightforward? (2) What was your primary blocker? (3) Likelihood to recommend (1-5). I'll wire the form and short webhook to capture replies.

aj-sales: For Finix let's add a quantitative success metric — target: reduce classifier latency p95 by 40% vs baseline. We'll use that in ROI comms.

priya-cs: Noted. @sam-analytics can you add dashboards for tokens/user, p95 latency, and model fallback rate so we can report early wins?

sam-analytics: On it. Will add a Grafana panel and a quicklink. ETA 48 hours, need read-only access to the infra telemetry.

maria-cs: I'll draft an enablement playbook sheet with quickstart prompts, common troubleshooting steps, and an SDK snippet. Will share a first pass by EOD Thurs.

devon-ps: I'll attach the workspace template and example prompts to the calendar invite.

priya-cs: Action items recap: (1) @aj-sales confirm seat ops + Finix ROI ask, (2) @maria-cs tag risks + draft playbook, (3) @devon-ps schedule workshop + build pulse forms, (4) @sam-analytics add dashboards, (5) onboarding-bot send enrollment emails on 4/03. I'll check in Fri EOD. Any blockers?

aj-sales: No blockers from sales — following up with Finix legal later today.

sam-analytics: Infra access required — pinging infra-team.

infra-team: Read-only access granted to sam-analytics for telemetry (token id: `infra-rc-23`, distributed via Vault).

priya-cs: Perfect, thanks all :tada: Will update the tracker and post the workshop invite once Devon confirms time.

maria-cs: One ask — can we run a short internal rehearsal with support for the first workshop? 20m sync the day before.

devon-ps: Good call. I'll block 20m Thu 4/02 09:30 PT for rehearsal and ping support.

priya-cs: Great — closing loop. If anything changes, drop it here. :white_check_mark:
